title: DocumentCapture v1
description: One captured federal document: its structure as nodes, its exact text as an ordered partition of evidence spans, and the provenance of both. Capture is not interpretation: nothing here states legal meaning. A family profile composes this schema through allOf and adds only its own node kinds and extension blocks; see spec/document-capture.md.

schema.description: The parent schema this document was validated against, pinned by digest so a consumer can refuse a document whose schema bytes it cannot reproduce.

id.description: Content-derived: sha256 over the artifact digest, converter id and version, profile name and version, and the text-stream digest. Two runs of one converter over one artifact mint one id.

idOrigin.description: Every node, span and region id in this document is minted by the converter. A consumer never reads one as a publisher identifier.

idScheme.description: How ids are minted. document-order: dense ordinals in document order, so the same input through the same converter version yields the same ids.

kind.description: What kind of bytes the publisher's artifact is. pdf means the artifact is a PDF, whose text order is established by the extractor document named in intermediate.

intermediate.description: The extractor document between the artifact and the text stream, when one exists. A PDF capture names three things: the publisher's bytes (artifact), the extractor's output (this), and the text stream every span addresses. Absent when the text stream is read straight off the artifact.

spanDefaults.description: Span source fields that are the same for every span of this document, stated once. A span's effective source locator is this object updated by the span's own; the effective locator must state a coordinateSystem. Hoisting the constants keeps one capture's bytes proportional to its text rather than to its span count.

nodes.description: Every structural node in document order. nodes[0] is the root and has kind document and parent null.

evidence.description: The ordered partition of the text stream: spans are contiguous, non-empty, and cover [0, textStream.codePoints) exactly. Concatenating exact in order reproduces the text stream; its digest is textStream.sha256.

unresolved.description: Runs of evidence no rule placed, kept with the issue that says why. A span belongs to exactly one node or one unresolved region, never both and never neither.

Iri.description: An absolute IRI, the same grammar rkaf:SourceFragment requires of oa:hasSource.

Artifact.description: The captured rendition bytes. Expressible as an rkaf:Artifact whose identifier scheme is rkaf:hash-sha256 and whose rkaf:hasContentDigest is sha256. The locator never carries a credential.

locator.description: Where the bytes were read from. A url is the publisher's stated address; a path is a retained fixture; a publisherId is the publisher's own identifier for the object (a GovInfo package id, a Federal Register document number).

retrievedAt.description: When these bytes were read, to the precision the retention record states: a full date-time when a request receipt records one, a date when the retained fixture's own README records only the day. Stating the day is not the same as stating nothing, and inventing a midnight would be worse than either.

identifiers.description: Publisher-stated identities of the document this artifact renders, each with the rkaf artifact identifier scheme it belongs to.

scheme.description: Copied from the rkaf artifact identifier scheme enum in rkaf-core.md §4.1, and re-pinned with it: a scheme added or retired there moves this enum and this schema's digest in the same change.

IntermediateArtifact.description: An extractor document standing between the publisher's artifact and the text stream: a PDF's retained extracted lines, for instance. It is a derived artifact, never the publisher's, and the capture names it so that a consumer following artifact.locator and checking artifact.sha256 lands on the publisher's bytes. Span page-region coordinates are the extractor's, and the producer that made them is named here.

producer.description: The extractor and line assembly that produced this document from the artifact, named well enough to re-run.

locator.description: Where the retained extractor document was read from. It has no publisher url: the publisher never issued these bytes.

PageSize.description: The displayed page's own size, in the unit RFC 8118 names for a PDF fragment's viewrect: points, 1/72 inch. A page node carries it so a permille Box can be converted back to the unit a PDF fragment identifier states.

TextStream.description: The derived text artifact every span addresses in Unicode code points. Its digest is the round-trip witness: sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the concatenated span text.

normalization.description: The stated function from the artifact to the text stream. reversible means the artifact's text can be regenerated from the stream plus the retained evidence coordinates; it never means the artifact bytes can.

Profile.description: The family profile that composed this schema. name is the prefix every namespaced node kind in the document uses; ext is the family's document-level extension block, constrained by the profile schema and left open here.

CoreKind.description: The closed structural vocabulary shared by every family. A family names anything else as <profile.name>:<Kind>. label is the publisher's designation element for its parent unit (a USLM num, a bill enum, a CFR SECTNO); the parent's designation repeats its text so the stream stays whole.

Derivation.description: How this node's structure was established. native: the publisher's own structural vocabulary. markup: derived from markup that is not that vocabulary (an HTML body split into blocks). pdf-text: an extractor's pages and lines. reconstructed: placed by a reconstruction rule or model over extracted lines.

Box.description: A displayed-page rectangle in integer permille of page width and height, top-left origin: [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Integers so the value is admissible to canonical identity JSON.

SourceLocator.description: Where in the artifact a node or span sits, in the artifact's own coordinates. utf8-byte: half-open byte range of the captured file; xml-node-path: an element path with sibling indices; page-region: a 1-based page and a Box; none: the artifact states no coordinate for it. A span's locator may omit any field rendition.spanDefaults states; a node's never does.

literal.description: utf8-byte only: the bytes in [start, end) are exactly the UTF-8 of the span text. False when a character or entity reference was decoded, in which case the range covers the reference.

Style.description: What the extractor observed about the type, never a claim about meaning.

start.description: Half-open Unicode code point interval over the text stream.

sha256.description: Over the UTF-8 bytes of exact: the value rkaf:fragmentContentDigest carries. Derivable, so a producer may omit it; a validator recomputes it either way and refuses a stated digest that differs.

source.description: The artifact's own coordinates for this span. Fields rendition.spanDefaults states may be omitted here; the effective locator is the defaults updated by this object.

tags.description: The inline elements enclosing this span inside its leaf, innermost last.

Decision.description: How a node was placed when a rule or model, not the publisher, decided it: the reconstruction package's own record.

ordinal.description: Dense position among the parent's children, from 0.

designation.description: The publisher's own label for the unit, verbatim: SEC. 2., (a), § 716.2, a printed page number.

level.description: Heading depth, 1 being the highest: the depth of the unit this heading opens, not the depth of the node in the tree. Absent means unlevelled, which is what a family states when its rendition marks no depth; it never means level 1. A family that sets it at all sets it on every heading it can.

pageSize.description: page nodes only: the displayed page's size in points, retained from the extractor so a permille Box resolves to a PDF fragment identifier's own unit.

text.description: Leaf nodes only, and never on a node with children: exactly the concatenation of this node's spans. Derivable from the spans, so a producer may omit it; a validator recomputes it and refuses a stated text that differs.

cell.description: Table cell geometry: zero-based row and column within the enclosing table, spans when the source states them, header when the source marks the cell as one.

ref.description: A figure or other node that stands for a resource the artifact does not carry inline.

derived.description: Text a named rule assembled from the exact spans (a print wrap's hyphen dropped, small capitals restored). The exact text stays in text; this is the derivative, and the rule that made it is named.

ext.description: The family's per-node extension block, constrained by the profile schema and left open here.
